items.title: Middle East Tourism Has Split. Which Demand Gets Capital?
items.snippet: Skift Take: Gulf travel now runs at two speeds. Pilgrimage and resort demand held through 2026, while long-haul and corporate travel fell away. Every 2027 capital and capacity plan for the region depends on which market an operator underwrites.

items.title: Lifetime Achievement: Sébastien Bazin springs a surprise to honour Serge Trigano
items.snippet: Serge Trigano received the Hospitality Awards Lifetime Achievement award on Monday 23 November at the InterContinental Paris Le Grand. The trophy was presented to him by Sébastien Bazin, Chairman and CEO of Accor, who came on stage for the occasion. It crowns three lives in hospitality: Club Med, Mama Shelter and, since October, the chairmanship of France Hospitalité.

items.title: Extended stay property in Florida sells for $22.75M
items.snippet: Staybridge Suites Naples - Marco Island by IHG has changed hands, reflecting the strength of the Naples and Marco Island market, per Ahmed Kabani, CEO of Kabani Hotel Group, which brokered the transaction. “The transaction delivered a premium valuation for the seller while providing the buyer an attractive basis in a high-barrier, supply-constrained market,” McLean said.

items.title: Malaysia Airlines orders 10 Boeing 787 Dreamliners
items.snippet: Malaysia Aviation Group (MAG), the parent company of Malaysia Airlines, has placed an order for 10 Boeing 787 Dreamliner aircraft directly from Boeing, with options for six additional aircraft, as part of its fleet modernisation strategy. Powered by GE Aerospace’s GEnx engines, the aircraft are scheduled for delivery between 2032 and 2035.

Powai Lake unveils musical fountain show in Mumbai
items.snippet: Mumbai’s Powai Lake has added a new attraction with the launch of a 180-metre-long musical fountain and light-and-sound show at Ganesh Ghat. Inaugurated by Maharashtra Cabinet Minister Mangal Prabhat Lodha on November 22, the attraction combines water displays, music, laser projections and fire jets to showcase Maharashtra’s history, cultural heritage and the legacy of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.

items.title: Barun Gupta elevated to Chief Executive Officer of INDEVA Hotels and Resorts
items.snippet: INDEVA Hotels and Resorts has announced the promotion of Barun Gupta from Chief Operating Officer (COO) to Chief Executive Officer (CEO), as the company prepares for its next phase of growth, portfolio expansion and brand development.
